paragraphs.text: Shifts last three hours and start at 9 am or 1 pm. Volunteers under 18 must work alongside an adult volunteer and may not lift boxes heavier than 10 kilograms.
Food that is past its use-by date is thrown away, even if it looks fine; food past its best-before date may still be given out. Any accident, however small, is written in the book by the door.

items.quote: Shifts last three hours and start at 9 am or 1 pm
items.prompt: Every shift is three hours long.

explanation.en: A shift lasts three hours → TRUE.

items.quote: Volunteers under 18 must work alongside an adult volunteer

explanation.en: Under 18 means working alongside an adult → FALSE.
explanation.ru: До 18 лет — только рядом со взрослым → FALSE.

items.quote: food past its best-before date may still be given out
items.prompt: Food past its best-before date is thrown away.

explanation.en: Use-by food is binned; best-before food may still be given out → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Use-by бойынша тастайды; best-before әлі таратылады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Выбрасывают по use-by; best-before ещё раздают → FALSE.

items.quote: Any accident, however small, is written in the book by the door
items.prompt: Small accidents do not need to be recorded.

explanation.en: Every accident, however small, is recorded → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Кез келген оқиға, тіпті ұсағы да жазылады → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Записывают любой случай, даже мелкий → FALSE.
